jyutping: zi1 dou3 A ge3 gai3 waak6

english.note: Use this when someone has become aware of or figured out another person's plan or secret.

examples.english: I finally caught onto Ming's plan—he wanted to quit.
examples.traditional: 我終於知道阿明嘅計劃，原來佢想辭職。
